(schema)  version=0
    markdown: "Coralogix Notification Center Connector. For more info please review - https://coralogix.com/docs/user-guides/notification-center/connectors/. **Note:** This resource is in Beta stage."
config_overrides  ListNestedAttribute optional computed
config_overrides[]  NestedObject
config_overrides[].entity_type  StringAttribute required
    description: "Entity type for the connector. Valid values are: [alerts cases test_notifications unspecified]"
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["alerts" "cases" "test_notifications" "unspecified"]
config_overrides[].fields  SetNestedAttribute required
config_overrides[].fields[]  NestedObject
config_overrides[].fields[].field_name  StringAttribute required
config_overrides[].fields[].template  StringAttribute required
connector_config  SingleNestedAttribute optional
    validator: notifications.connectorWriteOnlyFieldsValidator each field_values_wo entry needs a matching field_values_wo_versions entry, and must not also appear in fields
connector_config.field_values_wo  MapAttribute optional elem=basetypes.StringType
    markdown: "Secret values for connector fields, keyed by field name, which Terraform sends to the API and never writes to state. A field named here must not also appear in `fields`. Each entry needs a matching entry in `field_values_wo_versions`. Requires Terraform 1.11 or later.\n\nImporting is the one exception. An import has neither configuration nor prior state, so nothing identifies which field is a secret, and the API returns every field's value: the secret is written to state by the import itself. The following apply removes it again. Treat a secret that has been through an import as exposed, and rotate it. Reading the same connector through `data.coralogix_connector` also returns the value, under `connector_config.fields`: a data source reads from the API and has no configuration telling it which value is managed write-only."
connector_config.field_values_wo_versions  MapAttribute optional elem=basetypes.Int64Type
    markdown: "Version of each `field_values_wo` entry, keyed by the same field name. Increment a value to send a rotated secret: Terraform holds no copy of a write-only value, so it cannot notice that one changed. These versions are kept in state and are not secret."
connector_config.fields  SetNestedAttribute required
connector_config.fields[]  NestedObject
connector_config.fields[].field_name  StringAttribute required
connector_config.fields[].value  StringAttribute required
description  StringAttribute optional
id  StringAttribute optional computed
    markdown: "Connector ID. Can be set by the user or generated by Coralogix. Requires recreation in case of change."
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.requiresReplaceIfModifier If the value of this attribute changes, Terraform will destroy and recreate the resource.
    plan modifier: stringplanmodifier.useStateForUnknownModifier Once set, the value of this attribute in state will not change.
name  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Connector name."
    validator: stringvalidator.lengthAtLeastValidator string length must be at least 1
type  StringAttribute required
    markdown: "Connector type. Valid values are: [email eventbridge generic_https incident_io microsoft_teams pagerduty pagerduty_incidents service_now slack unspecified]. `incident_io` is a preview type."
    validator: stringvalidator.oneOfValidator value must be one of: ["email" "eventbridge" "generic_https" "incident_io" "microsoft_teams" "pagerduty" "pagerduty_incidents" "service_now" "slack" "unspecified"]
